answer_text: Azure handles PFS differently, so the DH group you configure on the Azure side must match the DH group configured in Cato. The KB notes that Azure uses different default IPsec settings for cloud VPNs, and you must align the IPsec settings (including the DH/PFS group) on both sides of the tunnel. Verify and set the same DH group in the Cato site configuration as Azure uses for its VPN, then reattempt rekey.
